title: (Un)Official LHS Server Modpack
description: This is the modpack from my school server so that anyone can play the mods installed
body:
This modpack was designed especially for our school Minecraft server to give it a stable, optimized, and enhanced multiplayer experience. It was designed to improve the original game while still maintaining the original Minecraft feel for players of all skill levels to be able to play it.
This modpack has a selection of mods that improve the game's performance, visuals, and quality of life without making the game overly complex. It allows the server to function smoothly while still providing additional game mechanics, world interactions, and game tools for the player.
Main Goals of the Modpack
Improve the game's performance and stability for multiplayer
Improve the game's quality of life
Expand the game's world
Maintain the vanilla feel for the game
This modpack is required to play the school server but is not required for other servers (unless you make one yourself)
